title: Indonesian Slang Dataset External Annotation Schema
description: External annotation schema for enriching dataset records without modifying the core five-field dataset structure.

record_reference.description: References the corresponding record in dataset/dataset_slang_indonesia.json.

domain.description: Primary contextual domain of the utterance.

annotation_principles: Annotations describe linguistic characteristics of synthetic records and must not be interpreted as verified demographic identity.
Regional classification represents simulated linguistic style rather than confirmed speaker origin.
One dataset record must have at most one primary value for each annotation dimension.
Annotation identifiers must reference valid identifiers defined in the corresponding taxonomy files.
The external annotation layer must not modify the original five-field dataset schema.
Synthetic records must not contain real-world personally identifiable information.
validation_requirements: Every annotation record must reference an existing dataset ID.
Dataset IDs must be unique within the annotation file.
Regional cluster identifiers must exist in regional_clusters.json.
Domain identifiers must exist in taxonomy.json.
Generation identifiers must exist in taxonomy.json.
Register identifiers must exist in taxonomy.json.
Code-switching identifiers must exist in taxonomy.json.
